moat_type: Artificial Intelligence and Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) Technology
primary_risk: Dependence on a few large customers
sector_survival_note: The sector faces disruption from emerging technologies, but NVIDIA's strong track record and diversified product portfolio increase its chances of survival.
thesis_summary: NVIDIA's AI and GPU technology rides the trend of increasing demand for high-performance computing and AI applications.
thesis_breaks_if: A structural change in the demand for AI and GPU technology, or a significant disruption in NVIDIA's supply chain.
sentiment_note: Accumulate slowly due to rich valuation.
ten_k_highlights: NVIDIA Corporation designs, manufactures, and markets graphics processing units (GPUs), high-performance computing and datacenter GPUs, and associated software for the gaming and professional markets.
The company's revenue for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2023, was $26.9 billion, an increase of 61% from the prior year.
NVIDIA's gross margin for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2023, was 74.1%, an increase of 10.1 percentage points from the prior year.
valuation_note: FCF yield 2.4%, PEG 0.6, EV/EBITDA 30, P/S 20 — priced ahead of fundamentals — accumulate slowly.
